decision: No pruning implementation or default change: only one additional strict dominance is established across the two frozen root snapshots per position.
scope: Both players, all root actions, iterative pointwise dominance over the remaining opposing actions. Shared-successor differences are computed with exact rational arithmetic over stored binary floating-point values, with a per-term roundoff margin. Kernel-equality candidates have identical stored coefficients and no pending mass, but equality of rounded probabilities is not an exact transition-kernel proof. They are reported separately and must not be used for pruning without an exact probability or rule-level equivalence proof. These are 82 snapshots of 41 positions, not 82 independent games. No downstream search savings or strength gain was measured.
